payload.reason:
Adjudication of the full-spectrum re-review recorded at sequence 87. Five axes returned no findings under the tightened bar (complexity, quality, security, language standards, codebase standards), and spec adherence is clean: every S3-B1..B9 behavior implemented, no scope creep. This is the second full pass over the candidate; the first (seq 80/81) found twelve, all dispositioned at seq 83, repaired, and verified resolved by refutation-grade re-verification; the delta re-review found nothing; this pass found two.

Both findings survive only in refutation-narrowed form, and both are minor test-adequacy gaps on the error pages - the last unpinned corners of the S3-B7/S3-B8 sentences:

(1) CE-M (minor): a delayed <meta http-equiv="refresh"> to a foreign origin in the 404 error-page body passes the Layer-1 same-origin scan (content not in URL_ATTRS, meta not in EMBEDDING_TAGS) and the Playwright fetch-set test never loads the 404 route, so the console.feature:414 same-origin property is unpinned there. Card seq 16 adjudicated meta refresh into BT1 scope; seq 18 cut the implementing extractor without a recorded exclusion, so the gap is a restoration duty, not a new demand. Fix shape: add meta-refresh content handling to the Layer-1 URL scan (or restore the seq-16 coverage at the error-page scan set).

(2) CE-N (minor): the S3-B7 hostile-content title row never requests an error page, but templates/error.html renders {{ card.title }} in a queue row through a separate template from queue.html, so an escaping bug specific to ErrorTemplate would ship green. Fix shape: plant the hostile marker as a Card title in one S3-B7 scenario and request the 404 (unknown Card) and corrupt-500 pages alongside the existing three, asserting the marker stays text at the error-page queue-row sink.

Both fixes are bounded test additions in tests/behavior/console/mod.rs; neither requires production changes unless fixing reveals a real escaping or scan bug. Disposition: route to the next fix round with the narrowed claims; after repair, refutation-grade re-verification of exactly these two claims suffices - no further full-spectrum pass is warranted unless the production surface changes.
payload.summary: Full-spectrum re-review adjudication: candidate clean on 5 axes; CE-M and CE-N stand in narrowed form (both minor, both error-page test gaps); queue for the next fix round
